title: Downgrade Difference Refund Amount — Northgate Memberships
content:
**Calculation note.** The downgrade difference refund on Northgate Memberships is the current-year Plus premium, that is the new membership and renewal fees paid for the current membership year net of refunds of them, less the annual fee of the base tier now held, never below zero and kept to the cent. A membership with no current-year Plus premium gets nothing.

**Inputs.**

1. *New membership and renewal fees paid for the current membership year:* the new membership fee and renewal fee charges on the ledger for the membership year now on the membership, less the refunds booked against those charges. Upgrade difference charges are not new membership or renewal fees and do not enter.
2. *Annual fee of the base tier now held:* the annual fee of the tier on the membership when the refund is worked.

## Worked figures (hypothetical memberships now held at Northgate Club Membership, annual fee 65.00)

| Current-year fees on the ledger | New membership and renewal fees, net | Less the base tier's annual fee | Downgrade difference refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| renewal 130.00 | 130.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 |
| renewal paid as a 20.00 certificate entry and a 110.00 card entry | 130.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 |
| renewal 65.00 plus an upgrade difference charge of 65.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 | nothing |
| renewal 130.00 with 10.00 already refunded against it | 120.00 | 65.00 | 55.00 |
